Statute of Limitations: You generally have 2 years from the date of the crash to file a personal injury lawsuit in Illinois (and 5 years for property damage). Briskman Briskman & Greenberg
Comparative Fault: Illinois uses a modified comparative rule, meaning you can recover compensation as long as you are 50% or less at fault for the accident (your payout is reduced by your percentage of fault). Briskman Briskman & Greenberg
Contingency Fees: Most reputable Chicago car accident lawyers work on a contingency fee, meaning you pay no upfront or out-of-pocket costs—they only collect a percentage if they win or settle your case. Disparti Law Group Accident & Injury Lawyers +1
